query: INSERT INTO user_permissions (user_id, permission) SELECT u.id, $1::text FROM users u WHERE u.status = 'active' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_permissions p WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.permission = $2::text) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_permissions s WHERE s.permission = $1::text) ORDER BY u.created_at, u.id LIMIT 1 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id
